overall_boundary: All estimates are synthetic fixtures used to test reporting mechanics; no model-performance conclusion is permitted.

claims.heading: Denominators
claims.allowed_sentence: The synthetic registry planned 20 paired episodes and contains 18 complete pairs; two are retained as missing rather than imputed.
claims.forbidden_stronger_claim: The formal experiment achieved complete coverage.

claims.heading: Primary paired estimate
claims.allowed_sentence: Within the 18 complete synthetic pairs, the paired success-rate delta was +0.11 with a 95% interval spanning zero.
claims.forbidden_stronger_claim: Repair significantly improves the real model.

claims.heading: Stage diagnosis
claims.allowed_sentence: The lowest synthetic conversion was observed at the alignment-to-action transition.
claims.forbidden_stronger_claim: Alignment is the causal failure mechanism.

claims.heading: Repair comparison
claims.allowed_sentence: The synthetic repair point estimate exceeded baseline, while uncertainty remained wide.

claims.heading: L0 retention
claims.allowed_sentence: The synthetic L0 retention rehearsal met its configured teaching threshold.
claims.forbidden_stronger_claim: The real checkpoint avoids catastrophic forgetting.

claims.heading: Oracle diagnostic
claims.allowed_sentence: The synthetic oracle condition was higher than deployable conditions and is reported only as a diagnostic upper bound.
claims.forbidden_stronger_claim: Oracle performance is deployable repair performance.

claims.heading: Resources and failures
claims.allowed_sentence: Synthetic accounting includes failed attempts in GPU-hour and estimated-cost denominators.
claims.forbidden_stronger_claim: Actual GPU cost has been measured.

claims.heading: Negative result
claims.allowed_sentence: The synthetic exact paired test did not reject equal margins at the configured alpha; this is not evidence of equivalence.
claims.forbidden_stronger_claim: Repair and baseline have no difference.
